name: The walking dead
text: Troubling news from beyond our borders: a strange sickness causes people to become rabid and aggressive, attacking others to spread their infection. Concerningly, they have been observed to still move even after receiving lethal blows...

choices.text: Barricade the doors and prepare for the worst.

name: Infectious miracle
text: Rejoice! Rejoice! Our prayers have been answered, and the blessings of the Great Infected One is spreading amongst the heathens! It is a sign for us to spread its teachings far and wide!

choices.text: Welcome the blessed into our ranks!
uniques: [1] free [Zombie Crawler] units appear <for [Infected Cult] Civilizations>
[1] free [Zombie Walker] units appear <for [Infected Cult] Civilizations>

name: Zombie vigor
text: The formerly-sluggish zombies have now been seen to move with startling speed - this new strain could cause a new wave of zombies at our gates.

choices.text: Prepare the defenses, and don't get infected!

name: Zombie mutation
text: Alarming news: new zombie types have been seen prowling among the infected, that seems to be adapting and specializing in response to our progress. Exercise caution.

choices.text: For the sake of our people, they must be culled.
